label: Beginner · Lesson 16
title: There is and there are
intro: My home: rooms and furniture. There is and there are. Today’s words and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Uyim: xonalar va jihozlar. There is va there are. Bugungi so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 16 · There is and there are. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: There is or there are?
items: There {is|are} a sofa in the living room.
There {is|are} two beds in my room.
There {is|are} a fridge in the kitchen.
There {is|are} four rooms in my house.
There is {a lamp|lamps} in the bedroom.
There are three {chair|chairs} in the kitchen.
Is there a TV? Yes, there {is|isn’t}.
{Is there|There is} a carpet in your room?

parts.title: Write There is or There are
parts.uz: Bo’sh joyga There is yoki There are yozing
items: ___ two sofas in the living room.
___ a red carpet in the bedroom.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: is / a / There / fridge / in the kitchen

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: Lola is my sister. {His|Her} bag is red.

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences about your house with There is and There are.
items.hint: Example: There are four rooms in my house. There is a sofa in the living room.
